meta.name: dropbox-automation
meta.description: Automate Dropbox file management, sharing, search, uploads, downloads, and folder operations via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Dropbox 文件、分享、搜索与文件夹操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要批量操作 Dropbox 文件或自动化文件流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate Dropbox file management, sharing, search, and folder operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to batch manage Dropbox files or automate file workflows

howto.what: Claude 可以搜索、上传、下载、分享和管理 Dropbox 中的文件和文件夹，包括批量操作和导出 Paper 文档。
howto.when: 当你要求操作 Dropbox 文件（如搜索、上传、下载、分享、创建文件夹等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 Dropbox 里名为“报告”的 PDF 文件。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具查找文件。

say.text: 把这份文档上传到 Dropbox 的 /工作 文件夹。
为 /照片/假期 文件夹创建一个公开分享链接。
say.note: Claude 会创建共享链接并返回 URL。

howto.what_en: Claude can search, upload, download, share, and manage files and folders in Dropbox, including batch operations and exporting Paper documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to perform Dropbox file operations such as search, upload, download, share, or folder management.

say_en.text: Search my Dropbox for a PDF named 'report'.
say_en.note: Claude will use the search tool to find the file.

say_en.text: Upload this document to the /Work folder in Dropbox.
Create a public share link for the /Photos/Vacation folder.
say_en.note: Claude will create a shared link and return the URL.
